ELIXIR_POTION.name: Elixir Potion
ELIXIR_POTION.text: Exhaust any number of cards in your hand.

ATTACK_POTION.name: Attack Potion
ATTACK_POTION.text: Add 1 of 3 random Attack cards to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

SKILL_POTION.name: Skill Potion
SKILL_POTION.text: Add 1 of 3 random Skill cards to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

POWER_POTION.name: Power Potion
POWER_POTION.text: Add 1 of 3 random Power cards to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

COLORLESS_POTION.name: Colorless Potion
COLORLESS_POTION.text: Add 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

FLEX_POTION.name: Flex Potion
FLEX_POTION.text: Gain 5 Strength. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Strength.

SPEED_POTION.name: Speed Potion
SPEED_POTION.text: Gain 5 Dexterity. At the end of your turn, lose 5 Dexterity.

BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.name: Blessing of the Forge
BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.text: Upgrade all cards in your hand for the rest of combat.

GAMBLERS_BREW.name: Gamblers Brew
GAMBLERS_BREW.text: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

DUPLICATION_POTION.name: Duplication Potion
DUPLICATION_POTION.text: This turn, your next card is played twice.

DISTILLED_CHAOS.name: Distilled Chaos
DISTILLED_CHAOS.text: Play the top 3 cards of your draw pile.

LIQUID_MEMORIES.name: Liquid Memories
LIQUID_MEMORIES.text: Choose 1 card in your discard pile and return it to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

SNECKO_OIL.name: Snecko Oil
SNECKO_OIL.text: Draw 5 cards. Randomize the costs of all cards in your hand for the rest of combat.

FAIRY_POTION.name: Fairy Potion
FAIRY_POTION.text: When you would die, heal to 30% of your Max HP instead and discard this potion.

SMOKE_BOMB.name: Smoke Bomb
SMOKE_BOMB.text: Escape from a non-boss enemy encounter. You receive no rewards.

ENTROPIC_BREW.name: Entropic Brew
ENTROPIC_BREW.text: Fill all of your empty potion slots with random potions.
